title: Mystery of the Turtle Shell
next_chapter_hook: When the projection of destiny fully manifested, Chen Ji finally understood — the bloodline of his Chen family was never an accident of this world, but a chess game meticulously designed by beings from a higher dimension.

text.content: Chaotic light poured into Chen Ji's meridians like tangible substance, and that aura from the same source as the Tianji Record instantly ignited the dormant fragment within his Mental Sea. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul violently trembled, an ancient voice exploding in his heart: "Steady! This is... impossible, how could it appear here!" Uncommon fear threaded through his tone. The cracks on the turtle shell were spreading visibly, and within those black qi-corrupted纹路, ancient golden inscriptions faintly emerged.

Chen Ji stared fixedly at the golden inscriptions, his heart pounding like war drums. These characters appeared in no classical texts he'd ever seen, yet the moment he saw them, he understood their meaning — it was a cosmic syntax beyond mortal comprehension, each character containing fragments of laws that could reshape heaven and earth. "Axis of Destiny... Observer Protocol... Seventh Generation Vessel..." Fragmentary terms flooded his mind, and simultaneously, a possibility he never imagined was taking shape: this heirloom left by his father had origins far more terrifying than imagined.

dialogue.content: The once overbearing messenger actually stumbled back three steps, his pupils filled with disbelief. His gaze locked onto the turtle shell, his voice trembling: "These patterns... impossible! This is a relic from the Old Heavenly Dao period, how could such a divine object exist in the mortal realm!" His imposing presence collapsed大半, "Observer... Seventh Generation... Could you be..." Before he finished, his body began uncontrollably drifting toward the turtle shell.

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, taking in every detail of the messenger's loss of composure. He didn't miss the keywords — Old Heavenly Dao, Observer, Seventh Generation Vessel. Each term was enough to cause catastrophic upheaval, but his face still wore the expression of a confused废物, only his fingertips slightly tightening his grip on the shell. "Senior, please don't mislead me," he said slowly, even forcing a silly grin, "Old Heavenly Dao, vessels — the young one knows nothing of such things."

dialogue.content: The messenger's face flushed to the color of liver, beast-like growls rumbling in his throat. He desperately resisted the诡异的 pulling force, yet in his struggles was dragged closer by several cun. "You ant! Heavenly Dao's Eye will not forgive you!" he snarled through clenched teeth, "Do you think this turtle shell is something good? It's precisely the tracker left behind by those traitors! Your Chen bloodline is merely the most failed seed in the experimental field!"

text.content: Experimental field? Seed? Chen Ji's heart sank sharply, yet his expression remained unmoved. His greatest skill was maintaining absolute calm in desperate situations, treating every vengeful word from enemies as puzzle pieces to collect. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang again, carrying a weighty tone: "He's not lying. The Tianji Record was the core fragment taken by Old Heavenly Dao Observers when they defected, and your bloodline..." The remnant soul paused, "was indeed specially modified to bear it."

The turtle shell's trembling grew increasingly violent, the chaotic light gushing from the crack had solidified into essence, transforming into wisps of golden threads wrapping around Chen Ji. Strangely, these threads caused him no harm; instead, as if confirming something, they gently touched his Brow Center, chest, and — the birthmark on his inner left wrist he'd never paid attention to. The birthmark blazed hot upon contact, revealing an insignia identical to the patterns on the turtle shell.

dialogue.content: At that moment, a blurred image emerged from the turtle shell's depths. The image showed a girl with features similar to his, imprisoned by chains in some dark space, surrounded by诡异的 silver runes — it was Chen Nian! Chen Ji's heart clenched painfully, and for the first time, undisguised killing intent flickered in his eyes. "Sister..." His voice was low as an abyss, "You'd best pray she's safe and sound, otherwise I'll show you what it means to beg for death without success."

text.content: The messenger's expression changed drastically; he never expected a mortal废物's gaze could make him feel like facing the abyss. Fear and fury intertwined as he abruptly mobilized all forbidden power within him, black qi surged forth, attempting to destroy everything in this final moment. "Perish together!" he grinned wickedly, "You think you can control it? Once this turtle shell fully activates, you'll be drained dry—"

choices.text: Risk the body, guide the turtle shell

choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk — if Heavenly Fate is below 50 points, will fall unconscious
choices.process_label: 他深吸一口气，做出了最疯狂的决定

text.content: Chen Ji fiercely bit his tongue, a mouthful of essence blood spraying onto the turtle shell. The instant blood mingled with chaotic light, he felt the Tianji Record fragment in his Mental Sea spinning wildly, a majestic force pouring back through his bloodline. His body felt torn apart and restructured; amid the excruciating pain, he heard Mo Xiansheng cry out: "Stop! Your meridians cannot withstand—" But before he finished, a golden stream of information had already crashed into his divine soul.

choices.description: Don't confront the runaway energy head-on, instead use the废物 persona to feign being overwhelmed, making the enemy relax vigilance — take advantage to find flaws for a decisive strike.

text.content: Chen Ji instantly收敛 all imposing presence, staggering backward, his face full of terror and helplessness. "Senior, spare my life!" he cried loudly, voice trembling; the messenger took the bait, grinning wickedly and increasing output: "Now you know fear? Too late!" However, just as the enemy was lost in triumph, Chen Ji's left hand hidden in his sleeve subtly formed a seal — what he wanted was never direct confrontation, but this fatal flaw.

text.content: Chen Ji ignored Mo Xiansheng's warning, focusing all his spirit on his sister's image. A "Niannian" like thunder exploded in his Mental Sea, and the blurred image actually turned toward him! On the girl's pale face, shock and ecstasy appeared; as her lips moved, she silently conveyed four words: "Brother... alive..." At this moment, Chen Ji felt a warm echo from distant spacetime.

choices.memory_label: 陈机在危急时刻依然牵挂妹妹，血脉联系超越一切阻碍

text.content: Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the turtle shell's changes continued. When the golden Axis of Destiny projection fully manifested, the entire underground ruin trembled. It was a massive axis penetrating the Void, with countless threads of fate缠绕 upon it, each thread connecting countless living beings — and Chen Ji clearly saw that he and his entire Chen family were merely insignificant nodes on this axis.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang again, this time with unprecedented solemnity: "Chen Ji, there are things I wasn't planning to tell you now... but since the Axis of Destiny has manifested, the mystery of your origins can no longer be hidden." The remnant soul paused, "Do you know that the Tianji Record choosing you was no coincidence?" Chen Ji gave no answer, simply waiting for the continuation. "Your father — Chen Xuan — he didn't die from heavenly tribulation, but actively walked that path."

Mo Xiansheng's voice was like ancient bells: "Chen Xuan was the last experimental subject of the Seventh Generation Observer Project. He carried the bloodline brand implanted by the New Heavenly Dao, yet during growth, he developed self-awareness awakening. The defectors from the Old Heavenly Dao found him, handing him the Tianji Record fragment, hoping he could break the control of the Two Heavens... And you, were the Eighth Generation he modified through secret arts before death — the Perfect Vessel."

dialogue.content: The messenger had been completely bound by golden threads, unable to move. His voice became hoarse and manic: "Who do you think you are? You're merely a chess piece in the game between Two Heavens! Old Heavenly Dao wants to use you against New Heavenly Dao, New Heavenly Dao wants to reclaim you to repair deficiencies... Hahahaha, you father and son are nothing but ants being manipulated!" His laughter abruptly stopped as a thread wound around his neck, "Now, time to be eliminated."

text.content: Chen Ji watched the messenger turn to ash amid agonized screams, yet felt no satisfaction in his heart. His mind was racing — his father's death, his own bloodline, Chen Nian's predicament, the origins of the Tianji Record... all clues were weaving into a picture he'd never imagined. He slowly opened his palm; the turtle shell had quieted, but that golden insignia was seared into his palm's depths, radiating faint warmth.

text.content: "Mo Xiansheng," Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm, "You endlessly speak of my father, yet never mentioned he was the Eighth Generation experimental subject. Are you my father's guardian, or an observer placed beside me by the Two Heavens?" Silence filled his Mental Sea; after a long while, Mo Xiansheng sighed: "You child... even more suspicious than your father. But since you asked, I'll tell you a secret even your father didn't know."

choices.description: Regardless of other matters, first completely digest the knowledge within the Axis of Destiny projection — strength is fundamental, truth can be sought slowly.

text.content: Chen Ji dove his consciousness into the turtle shell's depths, golden inscriptions flooding his Mental Sea like a tide. Pain coexisted with enrichment; he felt himself transforming visibly. When he opened his eyes again, golden patterns faintly swirled within his pupils — that was the mark of the Axis of Destiny. From now on, any scheme involving his fate would be visible to his eyes.

Just as Chen Ji was digesting the newly涌入 information in his mind, the insignia on his palm suddenly violently pulsed. Then, information from distant Void directly灌入 his consciousness — it was Chen Nian's voice, trembling uncontrollably: "Brother, don't come find me... the Holy Sect already knows of your existence... they're activating the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' plan..." The voice cut off abruptly, as if severed by some force.

Chen Ji's fists tightly clenched, knuckles cracking脆响. His expression remained calm as still water, but beneath his eyes, towering fury burned. Heavenly Fate Lock Key — so Niannian wasn't taken because she was a burden, but because she was a key component of the plan! He drew a deep breath, deeply burying this rage in his heart. Recorded, this debt, he recorded it. Once he'd sorted through all the truth, that would be the day the Holy Sect met its end.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's voice rang again, carrying exhaustion: "Child, you now know enough. The road ahead will be even more perilous, but I believe your father choosing you was right." He paused, "That 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' plan... it concerns you, and this turtle shell. When you truly activate its full power, you'll understand everything." His words were profound, "But now, you're still too weak."

text.content: Chen Ji slowly rose, placing the turtle shell into his chest. He didn't pursue further questioning because he'd already obtained the most crucial information — his father was not a victim, but a rebel; he was not a chess piece, but a chess player. Holy Sect, Heavenly Dao's Eye, Two Heavens' game... everything was just beginning. He looked up toward the ruin's ceiling, where the faint light seeping through seemed to herald the coming storm. "Niannian, wait for me." He silently vowed in his heart, "This time, it's the brother's turn to set the board."
